name: Temporal Fastest and Earliest-Arrival Paths
shortfall_explanation: The temporal path papers were reviewed, but no matching public GPU source release was verified. Static SSSP cannot replace time-respecting earliest-arrival/fastest-path semantics.
limitation_notes: A matching input variant can qualify without supporting every optional mode. Missing canonical adapters and absent runtime validation remain separate from research collection eligibility.
